===== capture-baseline-readonly.py =====
"""Capture the committed boundary before a new three-segment landing.
Read-only repository/source access. Refuses dirty tracked state or overwrite.
Usage: python3 campaign-artifacts/capture_next_baseline.py 208 209 210
"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, os, sqlite3, subprocess, sys
art=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
wt=art.parent/'campaign-worktree'
seqs=list(map(int,sys.argv[1:]))
assert len(seqs)==3 and seqs==list(range(seqs[0],seqs[0]+3))
batch=art/f'C05-{seqs[0]}-{seqs[-1]}'
assert not (batch/'baseline.json').exists()
def git(*args):return subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(wt),*args])
assert not git('status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=no').strip()
commit=git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()
prior=json.loads((art/'C05-205-207/baseline.json').read_text())
full=json.loads((wt/'data/alignment/alignment_full_v1.json').read_text())
ev=json.loads((wt/'data/alignment/alignment_evidence_v1.json').read_text())
boundary=seqs[0]-1
assert sorted({x['seg'] for x in full['links'] if x['course']=='C05'})==list(range(1,boundary+1))
hashes={}
for name in prior['sha256']:
    data=(wt/name).read_bytes()
    if name not in ('data/hgm_dictionary_v27_2.json.gz', 'data/full_parallel_corpus_v32.json.gz'):
        assert data==git('show',f'{commit}:{name}'),name
    hashes[name]=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
for name in ('data/hgm_dictionary_v27_2.json.gz','data/full_parallel_corpus_v32.json.gz'):
    assert hashes[name]==prior['sha256'][name]
refs=json.loads((art/'C05-205-207/heartbeat-preflight.json').read_text())['references']
assert all(Path(r['path']).is_dir() and os.access(r['path'],os.R_OK|os.X_OK) for r in refs)
fields=prior['source_snapshot_fields']
con=sqlite3.connect((wt/'build/hgm_spine_v27_2.db').as_uri()+'?mode=ro',uri=True)
con.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
con.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
for snapshot in ('source.json','context.json'):
    for row in json.loads((batch/snapshot).read_text()):
        actual=dict(con.execute('SELECT * FROM corpus_segments WHERE course=? AND seq=?',(row['course'],row['seq'])).fetchone())
        assert set(row)==set(fields) and all(row[k]==actual[k] for k in fields),(snapshot,row['seq'])
con.close()
out=dict(commit=commit,course_boundary=boundary,full_links=len(full['links']),null_exponents=sum(x['eng'] is None for x in full['links']),evidence_headwords=len(ev['pairs']),evidence_pairs=sum(map(len,ev['pairs'].values())),sha256=hashes,required_reference_paths_readable=len(refs),source_snapshot_matches_spine=True,source_snapshot_fields=fields)
(batch/'baseline.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))

===== prepare-semantic-supplement.py =====
"""Complete current-schema material supplement plus immutable raw input inventory."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json
b = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
target = b/'semantic-input-supplement.txt'
assert not target.exists() and not (b/'semantic-all-inputs.json').exists()
selected = {p for p in b.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.suffix in {'.md','.json','.diff','.py'}}
for folder in ('proposal-verification','proposal-verification-attempt02',
               'complete-originals-execution','complete-originals-execution-attempt02',
               'root-reconciliation-verification','root-reconciliation-verification-attempt01',
               'root-boundary-execution-attempt01','root-boundary-execution-attempt02'):
    selected.update(p for p in (b/folder).rglob('*') if p.is_file())
names = {'original-dispositions.json','final-decisions.json','final-tuples.json',
         'omissions-full.json','errata-five-ground-decisions.json','material-rulings.json',
         'source-preservation-proof.json','final-proof.json','intended-spans.json',
         'errata-analysis.json','errata-review.json','gap-review.json','occurrence-proof.json',
         'input-proof.json','completion-input-proof.json','evidence-references.json',
         'generator-proof.json','canonical-result.json','final-verification.json',
         'C15-271-physical-supplement.json','las-original-tier-records.json',
         'refutation-targeted-queries-full.json','capture-proof.json','register-check.json',
         'final-freeze-preflight.json','supported-copy-preflight.json',
         'source-input-pins.json','governing-manifest.json'}
for angle in ('tibetan','english','reconciled'):
    for seq in (271,272,273):
        selected.update(p for p in (b/angle/str(seq)).iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.name in names)
chunks = ['Complete material supplement. Read with the complete primary package and original raw inputs. Root checks are mechanical; root authored Tibetan. Tooling-only synthetic fixtures are not alignment approvals or source evidence. All actual alignment proposals, failures and source/copy mappings remain preserved.\n']
manifest=[]
for p in sorted(selected):
    raw=p.read_bytes();chunks.extend(['\n===== '+str(p.relative_to(b))+' =====\n',raw.decode('utf8')])
    manifest.append(dict(path=str(p.relative_to(b)),bytes=len(raw),sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()))
chunks.extend(['\n===== COMPLETE SUPPLEMENT MANIFEST =====\n',json.dumps(manifest,indent=2),'\n'])
with target.open('x') as f:f.write(''.join(chunks))
all_inputs=[]
for p in sorted(b.rglob('*')):
    relative=p.relative_to(b)
    if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in relative.parts and 'semantic-review' not in relative.parts:
        raw=p.read_bytes()
        all_inputs.append(dict(path=str(p),relative_path=str(relative),bytes=len(raw),sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()))
with (b/'semantic-all-inputs.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(all_inputs,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
result=dict(supplement_bytes=target.stat().st_size,supplement_sha256=hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),complete_material_files=len(manifest),all_raw_input_files=len(all_inputs),all_raw_input_bytes=sum(r['bytes'] for r in all_inputs))
with (b/'semantic-supplement-generation.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(result,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(result))

===== register-reviewed-page-and-index-v2.py =====
"""Register approved page91 before builders; never supplies semantic approval.

Prepared while reconciliation runs. Execution requires the separate completed
semantic approval, root acceptance proof and exact already-landed page body.
No database, generated export or source text is modified by this helper.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import ast
import copy
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess

B = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
W = B.parents[1] / 'campaign-worktree'
PAGE, SEQS = 91, [271, 272, 273]
BASE = '7166534a9f47a201e5ab580a843c14ba2a910891'
REVIEW = W / 'data/alignment/reviews_c05/c5p91'
PAGES = W / 'data/alignment/pages_c05'
OUT = B / 'landing/course-registration-verification.json'
ENV = dict(os.environ, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS='0', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')

def pin(raw):
    return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=W, env=ENV)

def course_pages(raw):
    tree = ast.parse(raw)
    assignments = [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign)
                   and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == 'COURSES' for t in n.targets)]
    assert len(assignments) == 1
    root = assignments[0].value
    assert isinstance(root, ast.Dict)
    current = next(v for k, v in zip(root.keys, root.values)
                   if isinstance(k, ast.Constant) and k.value == 'C05')
    assert isinstance(current, ast.Dict)
    entries = next(v for k, v in zip(current.keys, current.values)
                   if isinstance(k, ast.Constant) and k.value == 'pages')
    return ast.literal_eval(entries)

assert not OUT.exists(), 'Preserve earlier execution and outputs before another run'
assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == BASE
closed = json.loads((B.parent / 'integration/root-through270-closure/proof.json').read_text())
assert closed['status'] == 'PASS' and closed['final_head'] == BASE
meta_raw = (B / 'semantic-review/review.json').read_bytes()
meta = json.loads(meta_raw)
assert meta['verdict'] == 'APPROVE' and meta['open_findings'] == []
assert (REVIEW / 'review.json').read_bytes() == meta_raw
acceptance = json.loads((B / 'landing/root-semantic-acceptance-proof.json').read_text())
assert acceptance['page'] == PAGE and acceptance['segments'] == SEQS
assert acceptance['exact_final_hashes_counts_and_ranges']
assert acceptance['review_json_sha256'] == pin(meta_raw)['sha256']
# Tie every landed byte stream to the separately approved individual inputs.
# The actual landing helper serializes this ordered spec and the canonical
# generator concatenates its per-segment bodies with their terminating newline.
assert isinstance(meta['segments'], list)
assert [row['seq'] for row in meta['segments']] == SEQS
expected_spec = {'course': 'C05', 'segments': []}
expected_bodies = []
for row in meta['segments']:
    seq = row['seq']
    current = B / 'reconciled' / str(seq)
    accepted = B / 'semantic-review/reviewed-final' / str(seq)
    landed_accepted = REVIEW / 'reviewed-final' / str(seq)
    individual_spec = (current / 'spec.json').read_bytes()
    individual_body = (current / 'body.html').read_bytes()
    assert pin(individual_spec) == {'bytes': row['spec_bytes'], 'sha256': row['spec_sha256']}
    assert pin(individual_body) == {'bytes': row['body_bytes'], 'sha256': row['body_sha256']}
    assert individual_spec == (accepted / 'spec.json').read_bytes() == (landed_accepted / 'spec.json').read_bytes()
    assert individual_body == (accepted / 'body.html').read_bytes() == (landed_accepted / 'body.html').read_bytes()
    part = json.loads(individual_spec)
    assert part['course'] == 'C05' and [seg['seq'] for seg in part['segments']] == [seq]
    assert row['generator_exit'] == 0 and individual_body
    expected_spec['segments'].extend(part['segments'])
    expected_bodies.append(individual_body)
expected_spec_bytes = (json.dumps(expected_spec, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8')
spec_bytes = (W / 'data/alignment/specs_c05/c5p91.json').read_bytes()
assert spec_bytes == expected_spec_bytes
body = (B / 'landing/generator.stdout').read_bytes()
assert body == b''.join(expected_bodies)
assert (B / 'landing/generator.exit').read_text().strip() == '0'
assert not (B / 'landing/generator.stderr').read_bytes()
landing_meta = json.loads((REVIEW / 'landing.json').read_text())
assert landing_meta['course'] == 'C05' and landing_meta['page'] == 'c5p91' and landing_meta['segments'] == SEQS
assert landing_meta['generator_exit'] == 0
assert landing_meta['spec_sha256'] == pin(spec_bytes)['sha256']
assert landing_meta['body_sha256'] == pin(body)['sha256']
assert body and body in (PAGES / 'c5p91.html').read_bytes()

index = PAGES / 'index.html'
builder = W / 'tools/build_alignment_layer.py'
old_index, old_builder = index.read_bytes(), builder.read_bytes()
assert old_index == git('show', BASE + ':data/alignment/pages_c05/index.html')
assert old_builder == git('show', BASE + ':tools/build_alignment_layer.py')
text = old_index.decode('utf-8')
old_coverage = 'Reviewed campaign coverage: 270 of 511 source segments.'
new_coverage = 'Reviewed campaign coverage: 273 of 511 source segments.'
old_link = '<li><a href="c5p90.html">Page 90 · segments 268–270</a></li>'
new_link = '<li><a href="c5p91.html">Page 91 · segments 271–273</a></li>'
assert text.count(old_coverage) == text.count(old_link) == 1 and new_link not in text
assert list(map(int, re.findall(r'href="c5p(\d+)\.html"', text))) == list(range(1, 91))
new_text = text.replace(old_coverage, new_coverage).replace(old_link, old_link + '\n' + new_link)
assert list(map(int, re.findall(r'href="c5p(\d+)\.html"', new_text))) == list(range(1, 92))
assert new_text.count(new_coverage) == 1 and old_coverage not in new_text
for page in range(1, 92):
    assert (PAGES / f'c5p{page}.html').is_file()
new_index = new_text.encode('utf-8')

previous_line = b'    "c5p90": [268, 269, 270],\n'
added_line = b'    "c5p91": [271, 272, 273],\n'
assert old_builder.count(previous_line) == 1 and added_line not in old_builder
new_builder = old_builder.replace(previous_line, previous_line + added_line)
before_registry = course_pages(old_builder)
after_registry = course_pages(new_builder)
expected_registry = copy.deepcopy(before_registry)
assert list(before_registry) == [f'c5p{p}' for p in range(1, 91)]
assert 'c5p91' not in expected_registry
expected_registry['c5p91'] = SEQS
assert after_registry == expected_registry
assert [n for seqs in after_registry.values() for n in seqs] == list(range(1, 274))
compile(new_builder, str(builder), 'exec')  # Syntax only; no builder execution.

# Preserve both complete preimages before either authorized mutation.
history = B / 'landing/registration-preimages'
history.mkdir()
(history / 'index.html').write_bytes(old_index)
(history / 'build_alignment_layer.py.txt').write_bytes(old_builder)
index.write_bytes(new_index)
builder.write_bytes(new_builder)
assert index.read_bytes() == new_index and builder.read_bytes() == new_builder
result = dict(
    utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), status='PASS',
    page=PAGE, segments=SEQS, reviewed_head=BASE,
    only_transformations=['270 to273 index coverage', 'append exact page91 index link',
                          'append exact c5p91 registry entry'],
    index_before=pin(old_index), index_after=pin(new_index),
    builder_before=pin(old_builder), builder_after=pin(new_builder),
    registry_added_bytes=len(added_line), page_count=91, covered_source_segments=273,
    all_page_targets_exist=True, all_previous_registry_entries_exact=True,
    accepted_page_body=pin(body), accepted_page_spec=pin(spec_bytes),
    all_individual_approval_pins_match=True, exact_approved_spec_and_body_composition=True,
    actual_builders_executed_by_this_helper=0)
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

===== tibetan-brief.md =====
# Independent tibetan-first proposal: C05:271–273

Read ../proposal-protocol.md in full and its required project instructions.
Source and context snapshots are beside this brief. Independently verify the
six selected snapshot fields against full original read-only spine rows.

Use only this angle. Write only tibetan/271, tibetan/272 and tibetan/273.
Do not read other-angle, root-review-target, reconciliation or semantic files.
No delegation, repository/source/master edits, commits, browser/device/native
actions, web or paid APIs. Python bytecode disabled and SQLite URI mode=ro.

Read the complete local source argument and neighboring context before making
matches. Preserve useful defensible lexical coverage, exact repeated occurrences,
source roles and provisional producer labels. Full source text remains verbatim.
A null is an affirmative no-separate-exponent judgment; unresolved/distributed
translation stays omitted with an explicit reason. Any following selection
heading remains original apparatus under the registered class.

Deliver each final spec/body/report/errata, exact canonical stdout/stderr/exit,
measured counts and hashes, full material original evidence and all failed or
superseded attempts. No semantic approval is implied by a mechanical pass.
Freeze final files before reporting completion; any later correction must
preserve and explicitly supersede the prior frozen proof boundary.

Batch read whitelist: this angle brief, source.json, context.json, baseline.json
when root later creates it, and your own angle files. Do not glob or search the
batch parent directory; it contains withheld root and other-angle judgments.

===== verify-complete-originals-v2.py =====
"""Check frozen original transport and canonical fidelity; no semantic approval."""
from pathlib import Path
import datetime, hashlib, importlib.util, json, os, subprocess, sys, traceback
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
batch=Path(__file__).parent;wt=batch.parents[1]/'campaign-worktree'
out=batch/'proposal-verification-attempt02';out.mkdir()
proof={'started_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'status':'RUNNING',
       'role':'Root authored Tibetan; this is mechanical verification only, not independent semantic approval.'}
def pin(p):
    raw=p.read_bytes();return dict(path=str(p),bytes=len(raw),sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
def save(p,obj):
    with p.open('x') as f:json.dump(obj,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2);f.write('\n')
def freeze(angle,seq):
    directory=batch/angle/str(seq);fp=directory/'freeze.json';f=json.loads(fp.read_text())
    entries=f['files'] if isinstance(f['files'],dict) else {r.get('relative_path',r['path']):r for r in f['files']}
    expected={}
    for name,r in entries.items():
        key=str(Path(name).relative_to(directory)) if Path(name).is_absolute() else name
        assert key not in expected and not Path(key).is_absolute() and '..' not in Path(key).parts
        if Path(r.get('path','')).is_absolute():assert Path(r['path'])==directory/key
        expected[key]=r
    actual={str(p.relative_to(directory)) for p in directory.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p!=fp}
    assert actual==set(expected),(angle,seq,actual^set(expected))
    for name,r in expected.items():
        p=pin(directory/name);assert (p['bytes'],p['sha256'])==(r['bytes'],r['sha256']),(angle,seq,name)
    return dict(angle=angle,seq=seq,files=len(expected),freeze_sha256=pin(fp)['sha256'])
try:
    baseline=json.loads((batch/'baseline.json').read_text())
    for name,digest in baseline['sha256'].items():assert pin(wt/name)['sha256']==digest,name
    freezes=[freeze(a,s) for a in ['tibetan','english'] for s in [271,272,273]]
    own=json.loads((batch/'root-tibetan-boundary-verification.json').read_text())
    assert own['status'].startswith('PASS') and own['span_count']==94
    sys.path.insert(0,str(wt/'tools'))
    definition=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('canonical_generator',wt/'tools/gen_alignment_page.py')
    g=importlib.util.module_from_spec(definition);definition.loader.exec_module(g)
    sources={r['seq']:r for r in json.loads((batch/'source.json').read_text())}
    results=[];records=[]
    wrapper=batch/'tibetan/271/run-canonical-readonly.py'
    for angle in ['tibetan','english']:
        for seq in [271,272,273]:
            directory=batch/angle/str(seq);raw=(directory/'spec.json').read_bytes();spec=json.loads(raw)
            assert spec['course']=='C05' and [s['seq'] for s in spec['segments']]==[seq]
            argv=[sys.executable,'-B',str(wrapper)]
            started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
            run=subprocess.run(argv,input=raw,cwd=wt,capture_output=True,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'))
            label=f'{angle}-{seq}'
            for suffix,data in [('stdout',run.stdout),('stderr',run.stderr),('exit',(str(run.returncode)+'\n').encode())]:
                with (out/f'{label}.{suffix}').open('xb') as f:f.write(data)
            invocation=dict(started_at=started,finished_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                argv=argv,cwd=str(wt),environment={'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'},stdin=pin(directory/'spec.json'),
                exit=run.returncode,stdout=pin(out/f'{label}.stdout'),stderr=pin(out/f'{label}.stderr'),
                wrapper=pin(wrapper),canonical_generator=pin(wt/'tools/gen_alignment_page.py'))
            save(out/f'{label}.command.json',invocation)
            assert run.returncode==0 and not run.stderr,(angle,seq,run.stderr)
            assert run.stdout==(directory/'body.html').read_bytes(),(angle,seq)
            segment=spec['segments'][0];spans=segment['spans'];byid={s['id']:s for s in spans}
            assert len(byid)==len(spans) and segment.get('eng_order')
            tr=g.resolve(sources[seq]['wylie'],spans,'tib',seq)
            ordered=g.with_members(spans,[byid[i] for i in segment['eng_order']],sources[seq]['english'])
            er=g.resolve(sources[seq]['english'],ordered,'eng',seq)
            for span in spans:
                ident=span['id']
                records.append(dict(angle=angle,seq=seq,id=ident,d=span['d'],tib=span['tib'],eng=span['eng'],
                    tib_range=list(tr[ident]),eng_range=None if span['eng'] is None else list(er[ident]),
                    original_span=span,original_field_presence=sorted(span)))
            results.append(dict(angle=angle,seq=seq,exit=run.returncode,spans=len(spans),
                nulls=sum(s['eng'] is None for s in spans),body_bytes=len(run.stdout),
                body_sha256=hashlib.sha256(run.stdout).hexdigest(),spec_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                saved_body_identical=True))
    assert len(results)==6 and len(records)==sum(r['spans'] for r in results)
    assert freezes==[freeze(a,s) for a in ['tibetan','english'] for s in [271,272,273]]
    for name,digest in baseline['sha256'].items():assert pin(wt/name)['sha256']==digest,name
    save(out/'report.json',results);save(out/'root-resolved-spans.json',records)
    proof.update(status='PASS',finished_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        freezes=freezes,original_identities=len(records),canonical_replays=6,source_hashes_unchanged=True)
    save(out/'root-original-freeze-check.json',proof)
except Exception:
    proof.update(status='FAILED',failure=traceback.format_exc());raise
finally:
    save(out/'execution-proof.json',proof)
    print(json.dumps(proof,indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import datetime, hashlib, importlib.util, json, os, subprocess, sys, traceback
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
batch=Path(__file__).parent;wt=batch.parents[1]/'campaign-worktree'
out=batch/'proposal-verification';out.mkdir()
proof={'started_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'status':'RUNNING',
       'role':'Root authored Tibetan; this is mechanical verification only, not independent semantic approval.'}
def pin(p):
    raw=p.read_bytes();return dict(path=str(p),bytes=len(raw),sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
def save(p,obj):
    with p.open('x') as f:json.dump(obj,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2);f.write('\n')
def freeze(angle,seq):
    directory=batch/angle/str(seq);fp=directory/'freeze.json';f=json.loads(fp.read_text())
    expected=f['files'] if isinstance(f['files'],dict) else {r['path']:r for r in f['files']}
    actual={str(p.relative_to(directory)) for p in directory.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p!=fp}
    assert actual==set(expected),(angle,seq,actual^set(expected))
    for name,r in expected.items():
        p=pin(directory/name);assert (p['bytes'],p['sha256'])==(r['bytes'],r['sha256']),(angle,seq,name)
    return dict(angle=angle,seq=seq,files=len(expected),freeze_sha256=pin(fp)['sha256'])
try:
    baseline=json.loads((batch/'baseline.json').read_text())
    for name,digest in baseline['sha256'].items():assert pin(wt/name)['sha256']==digest,name
    freezes=[freeze(a,s) for a in ['tibetan','english'] for s in [271,272,273]]
    own=json.loads((batch/'root-tibetan-boundary-verification.json').read_text())
    assert own['status'].startswith('PASS') and own['span_count']==94
    sys.path.insert(0,str(wt/'tools'))
    definition=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('canonical_generator',wt/'tools/gen_alignment_page.py')
    g=importlib.util.module_from_spec(definition);definition.loader.exec_module(g)
    sources={r['seq']:r for r in json.loads((batch/'source.json').read_text())}
    results=[];records=[]
    wrapper=batch/'tibetan/271/run-canonical-readonly.py'
    for angle in ['tibetan','english']:
        for seq in [271,272,273]:
            directory=batch/angle/str(seq);raw=(directory/'spec.json').read_bytes();spec=json.loads(raw)
            assert spec['course']=='C05' and [s['seq'] for s in spec['segments']]==[seq]
            argv=[sys.executable,'-B',str(wrapper)]
            started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
            run=subprocess.run(argv,input=raw,cwd=wt,capture_output=True,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'))
            label=f'{angle}-{seq}'
            for suffix,data in [('stdout',run.stdout),('stderr',run.stderr),('exit',(str(run.returncode)+'\n').encode())]:
                with (out/f'{label}.{suffix}').open('xb') as f:f.write(data)
            invocation=dict(started_at=started,finished_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                argv=argv,cwd=str(wt),environment={'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'},stdin=pin(directory/'spec.json'),
                exit=run.returncode,stdout=pin(out/f'{label}.stdout'),stderr=pin(out/f'{label}.stderr'),
                wrapper=pin(wrapper),canonical_generator=pin(wt/'tools/gen_alignment_page.py'))
            save(out/f'{label}.command.json',invocation)
            assert run.returncode==0 and not run.stderr,(angle,seq,run.stderr)
            assert run.stdout==(directory/'body.html').read_bytes(),(angle,seq)
            segment=spec['segments'][0];spans=segment['spans'];byid={s['id']:s for s in spans}
            assert len(byid)==len(spans) and segment.get('eng_order')
            tr=g.resolve(sources[seq]['wylie'],spans,'tib',seq)
            ordered=g.with_members(spans,[byid[i] for i in segment['eng_order']],sources[seq]['english'])
            er=g.resolve(sources[seq]['english'],ordered,'eng',seq)
            for span in spans:
                ident=span['id']
                records.append(dict(angle=angle,seq=seq,id=ident,d=span['d'],tib=span['tib'],eng=span['eng'],
                    tib_range=list(tr[ident]),eng_range=None if span['eng'] is None else list(er[ident]),
                    original_span=span,original_field_presence=sorted(span)))
            results.append(dict(angle=angle,seq=seq,exit=run.returncode,spans=len(spans),
                nulls=sum(s['eng'] is None for s in spans),body_bytes=len(run.stdout),
                body_sha256=hashlib.sha256(run.stdout).hexdigest(),spec_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                saved_body_identical=True))
    assert len(results)==6 and len(records)==sum(r['spans'] for r in results)
    assert freezes==[freeze(a,s) for a in ['tibetan','english'] for s in [271,272,273]]
    for name,digest in baseline['sha256'].items():assert pin(wt/name)['sha256']==digest,name
    save(out/'report.json',results);save(out/'root-resolved-spans.json',records)
    proof.update(status='PASS',finished_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        freezes=freezes,original_identities=len(records),canonical_replays=6,source_hashes_unchanged=True)
    save(out/'root-original-freeze-check.json',proof)
except Exception:
    proof.update(status='FAILED',failure=traceback.format_exc());raise
finally:
    save(out/'execution-proof.json',proof)
    print(json.dumps(proof,indent=2))

===== verify-reconciliation-boundary-v2.py =====
"""Root mechanical check of the actual 271–273 schemas; not semantic approval."""
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import datetime, hashlib, importlib.util, json, os, sqlite3, subprocess, sys, traceback
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
b = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
wt = b.parents[1] / 'campaign-worktree'
shared = b / 'reconciled/271'
out = b / 'root-reconciliation-verification'
out.mkdir()
key7 = ('seq', 'id', 'd', 'tib', 'eng', 'tib_range', 'eng_range')
key8 = ('angle',) + key7
proof = dict(started_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
             status='RUNNING', role='Root authored Tibetan originals; mechanical verification only.')
def read(p): return json.loads(p.read_bytes())
def pin(p):
    raw = p.read_bytes()
    return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
def checkpin(p, expected):
    assert pin(p) == {k: expected[k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')}, str(p)
def save(p, obj):
    with p.open('x') as f: json.dump(obj, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2); f.write('\n')
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(['git', *args], cwd=wt, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout
def freeze(directory):
    fp = directory / 'freeze.json'; f = read(fp)
    items = f['files'].items() if isinstance(f['files'], dict) else [(r.get('relative_path', r.get('path')), r) for r in f['files']]
    entries = {}
    for name, record in items:
        path = Path(name)
        name = str(path.relative_to(directory)) if path.is_absolute() else name
        assert not Path(name).is_absolute() and '..' not in Path(name).parts and name not in entries
        if Path(record.get('path', '')).is_absolute(): assert Path(record['path']) == directory/name
        entries[name] = record
    actual = {str(p.relative_to(directory)) for p in directory.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p != fp}
    assert actual == set(entries), (directory, actual ^ set(entries))
    if 'file_count' in f: assert len(entries) == f['file_count']
    for name, record in entries.items(): checkpin(directory/name, record)
    if 'total_bytes' in f: assert sum(r['bytes'] for r in entries.values()) == f['total_bytes']
    return dict(directory=str(directory), files=len(entries), freeze=pin(fp))
try:
    baseline = read(b/'baseline.json')
    assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == baseline['commit'] == '7166534a9f47a201e5ab580a843c14ba2a910891'
    for name, sha in baseline['sha256'].items(): assert pin(wt/name)['sha256'] == sha, name
    original_freezes = [freeze(b/angle/str(seq)) for angle in ('tibetan', 'english') for seq in (271, 272, 273)]
    final_freezes = [freeze(b/'reconciled'/str(seq)) for seq in (271, 272, 273)]
    for r in read(shared/'source-input-pins.json'): checkpin(Path(r['path']), r)
    for r in read(shared/'supported-copy-preflight.json')['required_reference_access']: assert os.access(r['path'], os.R_OK), r['path']
    db = sqlite3.connect((wt/'build/hgm_spine_v27_2.db').as_uri()+'?mode=ro', uri=True)
    db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row; db.execute('PRAGMA query_only=ON')
    source_rows = [dict(r) for r in db.execute('SELECT * FROM corpus_segments WHERE course=? AND seq BETWEEN ? AND ? ORDER BY seq', ('C05', 271, 273))]
    assert [{k:r[k] for k in ('id','course','seq','acip','wylie','english')} for r in source_rows] == read(b/'source.json')
    sources = {r['seq']: r for r in source_rows}
    query_count = 0
    for r in read(shared/'queries-reopened-full.json') + read(shared/'refutation-targeted-queries-full.json'):
        actual = [dict(x) for x in db.execute(r['sql'], r['parameters'])]
        assert actual == r['rows'] and len(actual) == r['count'], (r.get('term'), r['sql'])
        query_count += 1
    for name, table in [('master-full-rows.json','entries'), ('corpus-full-rows.json','corpus_segments')]:
        for r in read(shared/name): assert dict(db.execute(f'SELECT * FROM {table} WHERE id=?', (r['id'],)).fetchone()) == r
    db.close()
    originals = read(b/'proposal-verification-attempt02/root-resolved-spans.json')
    original_by_key = {(r['angle'],r['seq'],r['id']): r for r in originals}
    assert len(original_by_key) == len(originals) == 198
    sys.path.insert(0, str(wt/'tools'))
    definition = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('canonical_generator', wt/'tools/gen_alignment_page.py')
    g = importlib.util.module_from_spec(definition); definition.loader.exec_module(g)
    finals = []; results = []; seen = []; dispositions = Counter(); extra_reasons = set()
    wrapper = shared/'run-canonical-readonly.py.txt'
    for seq in (271, 272, 273):
        directory = b/'reconciled'/str(seq); raw = (directory/'spec.json').read_bytes(); spec = json.loads(raw)
        assert spec['course'] == 'C05' and [s['seq'] for s in spec['segments']] == [seq]
        segment = spec['segments'][0]; spans = segment['spans']; byid = {s['id']: s for s in spans}
        assert len(byid) == len(spans)
        argv = [sys.executable, '-B', str(wrapper)]
        started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
        run = subprocess.run(argv, input=raw, cwd=wt, capture_output=True, env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'))
        for suffix, content in [('stdout',run.stdout),('stderr',run.stderr),('exit',(str(run.returncode)+'\n').encode())]:
            with (out/f'{seq}.{suffix}').open('xb') as f: f.write(content)
        save(out/f'{seq}.command.json', dict(argv=argv,cwd=str(wt),started_at=started,finished_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
             environment={'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'},stdin=dict(path=str(directory/'spec.json'),**pin(directory/'spec.json')),
             exit=run.returncode,stdout=pin(out/f'{seq}.stdout'),stderr=pin(out/f'{seq}.stderr'),wrapper=pin(wrapper),generator=pin(wt/'tools/gen_alignment_page.py')))
        assert run.returncode == 0 and not run.stderr and run.stdout == (directory/'body.html').read_bytes(), seq
        tr = g.resolve(sources[seq]['wylie'], spans, 'tib', seq)
        ordered = g.with_members(spans, [byid[i] for i in segment['eng_order']], sources[seq]['english'])
        er = g.resolve(sources[seq]['english'], ordered, 'eng', seq)
        local = [dict(seq=seq,id=s['id'],d=s['d'],tib=s['tib'],eng=s['eng'],tib_range=list(tr[s['id']]),eng_range=None if s['eng'] is None else list(er[s['id']])) for s in spans]
        decisions = read(directory/'final-decisions.json'); tuples = read(directory/'final-tuples.json')
        assert [x['tuple'] for x in decisions] == tuples
        assert [x['span_object'] for x in decisions] == spans
        assert [{k:x[k] for k in key7 if k != 'seq'} for x in local] == [{k:x[k] for k in key7 if k != 'seq'} for x in tuples]
        for t in tuples:
            parent = t['parent_id']
            if t['d'] == 7:
                assert parent and byid[parent]['d'] == 5
                for field in ('tib_range','eng_range'):
                    a,z = t[field]; p = next(v for v in tuples if v['id'] == parent)[field]
                    assert p[0] <= a < z <= p[1] and p != t[field]
            else: assert parent is None
        reasons = {x['rationale'] for x in decisions}; assert all(reasons)
        assert read(directory/'source-preservation-proof.json')['source_row'] == sources[seq]
        omissions = read(directory/'omissions-full.json')
        for field, sourcekey, rangekey in [('tib','wylie','tib_range'),('eng','english','eng_range')]:
            source = sources[seq][sourcekey]; covered = [False]*len(source)
            for t in local:
                r = t[rangekey]
                if r is not None:
                    a,z = r; assert source[a:z] == t[field]; covered[a:z] = [True]*(z-a)
            gaps=[]; i=0
            while i < len(source):
                if covered[i]: i+=1; continue
                j=i+1
                while j < len(source) and not covered[j]: j+=1
                gaps.append(dict(range=[i,j],text=source[i:j]));i=j
            assert gaps == [{k:r[k] for k in ('range','text')} for r in omissions['gaps'][field]]
            assert all(r['rationale'] for r in omissions['gaps'][field])
        for x in read(directory/'original-dispositions.json'):
            ident=x['original_identity']; assert set(ident) == set(key8)
            k=(ident['angle'],ident['seq'],ident['id']);seen.append(k);r=original_by_key[k]
            assert ident == {a:r[a] for a in key8}
            original_dir=b/ident['angle']/str(seq)
            original_spec=read(original_dir/'spec.json')['segments'][0]
            original_span=next(s for s in original_spec['spans'] if s['id']==ident['id'])
            assert original_span == r['original_span'] == x['original_span']
            assert list(original_span)==x['original_key_order'] and sorted(original_span)==x['original_field_presence']==r['original_field_presence']
            declarations = read(original_dir/'intended-spans.json') if ident['angle']=='tibetan' else read(original_dir/'decisions.json')['spans']
            assert next(d for d in declarations if d['id']==ident['id']) == x['original_occurrence_declaration']
            status=x['status'];dispositions[status]+=1;assert x['rationale']
            if x['rationale'] not in reasons:extra_reasons.add(x['rationale'])
            matches=[next(t for t in local if t['id']==i) for i in x['final_ids']]
            if status=='retained':
                assert len(matches)==1 and {a:ident[a] for a in key7 if a!='id'}=={a:matches[0][a] for a in key7 if a!='id'}
            elif status=='recast_or_boundary_or_depth_changed': assert matches
            else: assert status=='omitted_distributed' and not matches
        for x in read(directory/'errata-five-ground-decisions.json'):
            assert set(x['grounds']) == set('abcde') and x['refuted'] and not x['surviving_erratum']
            assert x['grounds']['a']['complete_row'] == sources[seq]
            assert x['grounds']['a']['verbatim_in_current_fields'] == {k:x['found'] in sources[seq][k] for k in ('acip','wylie','english')}
        assert read(directory/'errata.json') == [] and read(directory/'proposed-head-allowances.json') == []
        finals.extend(local)
        results.append(dict(seq=seq,exit=run.returncode,spans=len(spans),nulls=sum(s['eng'] is None for s in spans),word_pairs=sum(s['d']==5 and s['eng'] is not None for s in spans),body_bytes=len(run.stdout),body_sha256=pin(directory/'body.html')['sha256'],spec_bytes=len(raw),spec_sha256=pin(directory/'spec.json')['sha256'],saved_body_identical=True))
    assert len(finals)==102 and len(seen)==len(set(seen))==198 and set(seen)==set(original_by_key)
    assert dispositions==Counter(retained=181,recast_or_boundary_or_depth_changed=16,omitted_distributed=1) and len(extra_reasons)==3
    whitelist={'.json','.md','.html','.stderr','.stdout','.log','.txt','.bin','.exit'}
    mappings=read(shared/'original-copy-manifest.json')
    for r in mappings:
        original=Path(r['original']); copy=shared/r['copy']
        checkpin(original,r);checkpin(copy,r);assert original.read_bytes()==copy.read_bytes() and copy.suffix in whitelist
    for r in read(shared/'governing-manifest.json'):
        copy=Path(r['copy']['path']);checkpin(copy,r['copy']);assert copy.read_bytes()==git('show',r['git_commit']+':'+r['git_path'])
    physical=read(shared/'C15-271-physical-supplement.json')
    original=Path(physical['original']['path']);copy=Path(physical['copy']['path'])
    checkpin(original,physical['original']);checkpin(copy,physical['copy']);a,z=physical['range']
    assert original.read_bytes()[a:z]==copy.read_bytes()==physical['complete_extent_latin1'].encode('latin1')
    for r in read(shared/'physical-reopened-full.json'):
        if isinstance(r['original'],dict):
            original=Path(r['original']['path']);checkpin(original,r['original']);a,z=r['byte_range'];raw=original.read_bytes()[a:z]
            assert len(raw)==r['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==r['sha256'] and raw==r['full_extent_latin1'].encode('latin1')
        else:
            original=Path(r['original']);checkpin(original,dict(bytes=r['original_bytes'],sha256=r['original_sha256']))
            raw=original.read_bytes()[r['extent_start_byte']:r['extent_end_byte']]
            assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==r['extent_sha256'] and raw==r['extent_utf8'].encode('utf8')
            assert (shared/r['copy']).read_bytes()==original.read_bytes()
    for name,sha in baseline['sha256'].items(): assert pin(wt/name)['sha256']==sha
    assert final_freezes == [freeze(b/'reconciled'/str(seq)) for seq in (271,272,273)]
    assert original_freezes == [freeze(b/angle/str(seq)) for angle in ('tibetan','english') for seq in (271,272,273)]
    assert git('status','--short').decode() == '?? data/teaching/dcc_captions\n'
    save(out/'resolved-spans.json',finals);save(out/'report.json',results)
    proof.update(status='PASS mechanical handoff only',finished_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),baseline=baseline['commit'],original_freezes=original_freezes,reconciled_freezes=final_freezes,original_identities=198,final_tuples=102,nulls=8,nonnull_d5=63,dispositions=dict(dispositions),original_full_objects_and_occurrence_declarations_exact=True,complete_omission_complements_exact=True,query_replays=query_count,material_copy_records=len(mappings),governing_git_pins=11,physical_extents_reopened=11,all_rationales_read=True,additional_unique_original_rationales=3,canonical_replays=3,source_pins_unchanged=True,semantic_approval=False)
except Exception:
    proof.update(status='FAILED',failure=traceback.format_exc());raise
finally:
    save(out/'root-frozen-evidence-check.json',proof)
    print(json.dumps(proof,ensure_ascii=False))
